metadata.collection_note: Partial live collection: LanguageTool API, DeepL Write, TextGears web checker, and JSpell Free Web Checker have outputs for H-01 through H-10 in en-US and en-GB. TextGears was set explicitly to American or British; its first visible suggestion was applied once per issue, with no recheck, and web-demo latency was not measured. The paired evaluator must reject this cache until all seven engines have all ten passage outputs in both locales. BCorrect's Test-Demo portal infers dialect from writing style but offers no explicit locale control and reports three passes in Standard mode, so it cannot provide separate controlled locale outputs. Sapling and Grammarly paired captures remain unavailable.
